currentSkills.currentText: 出牌阶段限一次，你可以与至多三名角色同时拼点，没赢的角色弃置一张牌或令你摸一张牌。若你没赢，你获得1枚“饶舌”标记，若标记数为7，你死亡。
当你亮出拼点牌后，若点数小于等于X，你可以令之点数+X并令“鼓舌”视为未发动（X为你的“饶舌”标记数）。

mechanism.commonCommit: One original own hand input and one actual entity per ordered opponent remain private until all participants commit. Forced random source may replace the original input once. Hand materials pay PindianReveal at common reveal; top materials are already privately reserved in Processing with one exact actual movement invoice and are then publicly revealed together.
mechanism.currentJiCi: Optional own reveal rank<=live Raoshe; coupled +X rank (maximum13) and exact associated Gushe phase activation refund. Applies source and opponent cards of an ordinary native pair too. Legacy281 is excluded.
mechanism.nonwinner: Ordered comparisons reuse the same source entity; ties classify both participants as not-won. Each living nonwinner pays one actual owned hand/equipment discard or permits one source draw. Source mark precedes source consequence.
mechanism.threshold: Exactly seven actual self-sourced Raoshe directly enters native death at positive HP with no invented damage, dying/rescue or killer. Common materials are settled once before native death; issued comparisons survive source loss/non-lord death.
mechanism.coldAndPayments: Typed group/reveal frames own all cursors, immutable entity lists and movement invoices. Actual nested movement/recovery/dying children require exact root and paid journal evidence.
mechanism.legacyBoundary: Existing single-opponent Pindian validation remains strict; its alternate reveal subtree requires the new operation catalog, exact original pair parent and processing entities. No rules/schema/package epoch bump.
mechanism.resultClaims: Typed per-comparison public claim cursor supports existing PindianClaim, PindianClaimAllWhenSourceWins and PindianMaximumSlashClaim policies. It freezes original owners/policy sources/entity IDs, moves only still-Processing entities into the claimant hand with an exact paid movement invoice, drains native children, and never reclaims or finishes a previously obtained entity.
mechanism.policySelections: The native random-policy collector is shared with unchanged old pair. Candidates finish before top selection; first paid RNG receipt fixes each target once, including the common source. Original activation input and actual random source have separate typed proof. Each Tianbian top actually moves DrawPile to Processing under skill.pindian.reserve-top once, retaining its private immutable receipt and exact sequence. Public CardMoved callback/fact and all safe viewer Processing counts/public cards conceal these private materials until common reveal. Real deck depletion may reshuffle discarded cards for another top while earlier reserved entities remain held. The common reveal pays only remaining hand materials and drains real movement/draw children without consuming held tops.
mechanism.orderingEvidence: Readable UTF-8 official 20161216 guide supports GuShe simultaneous common card, sequential comparisons and self mark before own consequence. Current JiCi is verified separately against current350/3307. No current same-version FAQ for multiple policies targeting one simultaneous common source was found; first-paid target exclusivity follows the native one-target/one-RNG-receipt invariant and is not presented as official FAQ.
